geo_competing_hypotheses.description: Reduce code-block and table surface contribution directly in surface calculation
Require citation/architecture evidence before high GEO buckets (4 and 5) become reachable
Make code/table evidence conditional on presence of a valid technical pitch and clear scope definition
Introduce separate evidence-quality tiers distinguishing syntax examples from formal machine citability assets

non_negotiable_invariants: Real Test (24 repos) is held-out and strictly inaccessible to the optimizer
Human Gold Evaluation subset (15 repos) is strictly inaccessible to the optimizer
Synthetic Train/Val and Real Train/Val are the only permitted training/tuning signals
